Hello @Kyle Kimmerly,

As requested, I’ve changed the timer to 60 minutes. Please let me know if this is enough time or if any further action is required on our side.

If the issue persists, could you share an estimate of how much time passes before the automatic logout triggers? This will help us rule out possible cache or configuration issues. I would also recommend clearing the browser’s cache and signing out and back in before testing.

","created":"2026-10-01T11:41:42.853-0400","updated":"2026-10-01T11:41:42.853-0400","updateAuthor":{"accountId":"712020:153a3fea-8720-4528-b10f-5196a5d5fb21","displayName":"Enrique Jimenez"},"jsdPublic":true},{"id":"3374314","author":{"accountId":"qm:77071153-8149-425d-9cc5-2ef53c35a3bd:67c18952-dd38-454f-b2c1-dad0161cebb4","displayName":"Kyle Kimmerly"},"body":"

Hello,

The 60 minute timer is an improvement, but still impacts workflows when someone steps away for an extended period of time which happens regularly as part of our investigators day - the most common reason being to conduct an integrity interview - and wishes to return to what they were doing. Nearly all of our users cannot access their search history as they do not have search writing permissions so cannot easily recover the pages that are lost.

Can the timer simply be completely disabled again? We had it removed very early into our time with Secure 5 and did not request it to be added back.

All Kohl’s laptops already automatically lock after 15 minutes to protect data in the event that a laptop is left unsecured.

Thank you,
